comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
Also, manually selecting all the fields i want is not really an option, since these fields will differ depending on the query result, and there can be dozens of fields.

Here is what i suspect is happening:

The query has a relative interval of 2 minutes. 
The telegraf ping sensors, obviously, don't have the same exact time stamp for every result, since they are pings different devices.
I think the count transformation is not fully countng all the results in the last 2 mins, and instead, only counting a much smaller interval.

comments.body:
I currently have zero downed switches in my environment, so unfortunately, I can't pull that data for you from my live environment. 
But, this should be really easy to replicate on a test environment, it's a simple ping sensor on telegraf, polling each switch with pings.

````
[[inputs.ping]]
  interval = "1s"
  method = "native"
  urls = ["192.168.31.111"]
  count = 3
  ping_interval = 0.3
  [inputs.ping.tags]
     name = "Name Of This Switch"
     location = "Building Name"
     bucket = "switches"
````

All you need is one of these for each IP you want to ping.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
Ok, quick update:

I changed my query from:
````
SELECT * from (
SELECT last("percent_packet_loss") as packetloss FROM "ping" WHERE ("bucket" = 'switches' ) AND $timeFilter
) where "packetloss" > 0
GROUP BY "name"
````
to
````
SELECT COUNT("percent_packet_loss") FROM "ping" WHERE ("bucket" = 'switches') AND ("percent_packet_loss" > 0) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY "name"
````
And it seems to be working now. 
Still doesn't explain why it worked on all previpus grafana versions and stoped working from version 9.5+

But, for me, i'm just glad its working with this query, and i'll be able to keep my grafana up-to-date.
(Eventhough my new query does selec count, i'm still having to apply the transformation to add all the results. not really sure why)

comments.author: participant5
comments.body: it could be due to the fields name coming from influxdb. If you dont specify any fields in the transformation, it tries to do some magic and decide which ones to use using some field matching heuristic. Try to alias each field with specific names and see if there is a difference between version.
